ThingDef.label: Advanced Shield Generator
ThingDef.description:
A smaller shielding device which projects a momentum repulsor field. Shots can go out, but not in.

Generates heat when it blocks attacks. If no heatsink capacity is available, the shield will be damaged and require repairs.

Ship radiators cannot disperse heat while shields are up. Captains are advised to drop shields once heatsinks are close to capacity, or risk their ships turning into ovens.

ThingDef.label: Nanotech Shield Generator
ThingDef.description:
A tiny generator which projects a momentum repulsor field with enhanced EMP resistance. Shots can go out, but not in.

Generates heat when it blocks attacks. If no heatsink capacity is available, the shield will be damaged and require repairs.

Ship radiators cannot disperse heat while shields are up. Captains are advised to drop shields once heatsinks are close to capacity, or risk their ships turning into ovens.
